question: Select the correctly spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is **Influence**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The only word which is spelled correctly in the given options is: Influence
 
• The word Influence means 'the power to affect, change or control somebody/something (**व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु को प्रभावित, या नियंत्रित करने की शक्ति**)'.
 
 
• Example:* Television can have a strong **influence** on children.*
 
• Synonyms: impact, consequence, etc.
 
• Antonyms: insignificant, unimportant, etc.

 
 
 

Hence, option 2 is the correct choice.
